summary: Legs A day. Lunch introduces Grilled Pickle Brined Chicken and dinner introduces Smoked Salmon for protein variety, both new mains not used in recent days; wild rice, sweet potato and black beans cover the extra leg-day carbs and fiber.

meals.name: Uber Breakfast
meals.note: Oats, eggs, turkey and bread for a protein/carb base, banana to round out carbs.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
meals.note: Grilled Pickle Brined Chicken as the main for variety, wild rice and black beans for carbs and fiber, extra chicken breast to round out protein.

meals.name: Uber Pre-workout
meals.note: Low-fat carbs and protein 60-90 min before lifting: today's wellness protein smoothie, lean turkey, and berries for fiber without added fat.

meals.name: Uber Post-workout / Dinner
meals.note: Smoked Salmon (half portion to keep fat in check) for protein-source variety on a leg day, extra turkey, sweet potato, wild rice and black beans close out protein and the day's higher carb target.
